title: Distribution of Bell State Entanglement in Qubit Networks via Collision Models
summary: We investigate the selective generation of Bell-pair entanglement in three qubit networks using a standard quantum collision model. By varying the network geometry, the node contacted by the ancilla, and the interaction Hamiltonians, we identify configurations in which high pairwise concurrence and Bell state fidelity are generated between different target qubits, including nonadjacent qubits and qubits not directly coupled to the ancilla.
